end.summary: Compared food journeys by adding distances across farm, market, shop, and home.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised linking longer food journeys with more fuel use, pollution, and reduced freshness. They also suggested seasonal fruit, local farmers, and a kitchen garden, and used total distance when comparing examples. Rohan still mixed up imported food with being better or more nutritious; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to compare two foods and name one benefit and one limit of choosing the nearer option.
